sql:
SELECT
    cohort_year,
    total_customers,
    returning_customers,
    round(returning_customers / total_customers, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        cohort_year,
        count(DISTINCT CustomerKey) AS total_customers,
        countDistinctIf(CustomerKey, has_return = 1) AS returning_customers
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.CustomerKey,
            toYear(min(s.DateKey)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.CustomerKey) AS cohort_year,
            max(if(toYear(s.DateKey) > toYear(min(s.DateKey)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.CustomerKey), 1, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.CustomerKey) AS has_return
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s
    )
    GROUP BY cohort_year
)
ORDER BY cohort_year
